environment: Linux headless Chromium; synthetic data; SQLite component backend; production Vue build

scenarios.scenario: Production build, initial theme and login fields survive keyboard theme toggle
Current SLR10 navigation and saved theme survive report navigation/reload
Card correction preserves form on theme change and creates a new version
Confirmation and official submission are separate, version-bound actions
Recipient notifications can be read without exposing another account notification
History shows original card/source and compares parent without current-result mixing
NON_EVENT remains blocked and category is not editable
Narrative revision disables the old card and requests explicit NARRATIVE_REVISION
Lost correction response recovers committed state using reads without duplicate POST
Revision conflict retains local edits and never silently rebases/resubmits
Mobile menu, reading and form layout fit 390px and 320px
Denied storage falls back to device theme and retains manual choice across navigation
PWA caches assets only; offline blocks writes and reload does not restore private drafts
Saved text becomes read-only; explicit edit replaces the active text and reload retains its original archive
Replacing audio retains one active recording, the current text and both originals in the archive
Three images join the active sources automatically and a fourth is rejected before uploading
One click prepares exactly the active TAI sources after consent; explicit retry reuses the committed bundle
Lost bundle response blocks analysis; reading committed state allows an explicit retry without a duplicate bundle
Paginated saved evidence is fully read before writes and selects the latest text without losing originals
Report filters, sorting and pagination use the server query and accurate totals
Reporter list remains readable in both themes and at 390/320px with keyboard-operated theme controls
Refined review preserves seven fields, uncertainty, keyboard editing and private PWA asset boundaries in a fresh signed-in session

limits: Not a physical mobile device or Windows check
No real AI inference; narrative handoff intentionally returns AI_CONFIGURATION_NOT_READY in the unconfigured QA server
PostgreSQL locking/trigger tests were not executed in this environment
